extracted_claim: Godot ProjectSettings stores properties in an RBMap<StringName, VariantContainer> where each container holds: variant value, ordering int, persist flag, basic flag, internal flag, initial value, hide_from_editor flag, restart_if_changed flag. Version tracking uses uint32_t _version with HashSet<StringName> changed_settings for dirty tracking. GLOBAL_DEF macros auto-register settings. GLOBAL_GET_CACHED uses SpinLock + version check for thread-safe cached reads.
implementation_relevance: HSE has no project settings system. Godot's approach shows how to do versioned, thread-safe settings with dirty tracking.

extracted_claim: Godot's autoload system stores: StringName name, String path, bool is_singleton. Managed via HashMap<StringName, AutoloadInfo> with add/remove/has/get operations. Autoloads are project-level singletons auto-instantiated at startup. fix_autoload_paths handles path migration.
implementation_relevance: HSE has no service locator or global registry pattern. Autoload is a form of dependency injection.

extracted_claim: Godot ResourceUID maps int64_t IDs to CharString paths via HashMap<ID, Cache>. Uses dual cache: forward (ID->path) and reverse (path->ID) for bidirectional lookup. create_id_for_path generates deterministic IDs from path strings. Cache persisted to disk via encode_binary_cache. Mutex-protected for thread safety. uid_to_path/path_to_uid static helpers for runtime resolution.
implementation_relevance: HSE has no resource UID system. This is essential for stable references across file renames.

hse_symbol_grounding.notes: HSE has no resource ID system
